Bill.BriefDescription: Providing tax exemptions for storm water mitigation projects.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing tax exemptions for storm watermitigation projects; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; addinga new section to chapter 82.12 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales ofmaterials used for storm water mitigation projects. The tax also doesnot apply to labor and services rendered for the installation orconstruction of storm water mitigation projects. The exemption isavailable for a person that contracts with a local government ordepartment of transportation for storm water mitigation projects, andfor storm water mitigation projects on private property designed orprovided for a person. (2) For the purposes of this section, the following definitionsapply: (a) "Local government" means a political subdivision covered bynational pollutant discharge elimination system municipal phase I orphase II permits. p. 1 HB 1996 (b) "Low-impact development" means a storm water management andland use strategy applied at the parcel, subdivision, or drainage arealevel, that emphasizes conservation and use of on-site natural featuresintegrated with engineered, small scale hydrologic controls to moreclosely mimic predevelopment hydrologic functions. (c) "Person" has the same meaning as in RCW 82.04.030. (d) "Retrofit" means renovation or improvements associated with andconstructed adjacent to or near an existing site, subdivision, ordevelopment in order to reduce or eliminate municipal storm waterrunoff to receiving water bodies. (e) "Storm water facility" includes, but is not limited to, ponds,biofiltration swales, storm water treatment tanks, detention vaults,oil water separators, dry wells, catch basins, filters, perviousasphalt, and rain gardens. (f) "Storm water mitigation projects" means construction orretrofit of a storm water facility, including projects that utilizelow-impact development retrofit strategies, or projects that mitigateor prevent storm water pollutants in receiving waters previouslyremediated under federal or state-approved activities. (3) A person claiming the exemption under this section must claimthe exemption in a form and manner prescribed by the department.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to the useof materials for storm water mitigation projects on storm waterfacilities. The provisions of this chapter also do not apply to theuse of labor and services rendered for the installation or constructionof storm water mitigation projects on storm water facilities. Thedefinitions and requirements in section 1 of this act apply to thissection.
